contexts.text: When anyone first comes into the eternal life, he is among the Angels, and therefore seems to himself as if it were in the flower of youth.
(These women) come more and more into the flower of womanhood and of youth.
The Angels are constantly advancing to a life of young manhood and youth.
The state of adolescence and youth (as to the new life) is that regard is no longer had to any person as he appears... but to his quality as to good...
Those in Heaven are continually brought by the Lord into a more perfect life, and at length into the flower of youth...
This (opening of the Rational) takes place especially in the youthful age even to the adult, and progressively...
(In Jupiter) they marry in the first flower of youth.
The third state is from the twentieth to the sixtieth year, which is a state of intelligence, and is called adolescence, youth, and manhood.
Other Spirits are with man in adolescence and youth, and others in old age.
Infants in Heaven do not grow up beyond the first manhood... (Compare CL 444:8.)
If, in youth, when they think from their own understanding...
From infancy to the youthful age, man is in the external of thought from the affection of knowing, which then makes its internal...
All who have lived well, when they come into Heaven, come into the age that in the world is their youthful age, and remain in it to eternity...
They had learned in their youth to confirm faith alone...
The (angelic) husband appeared in the middle age between youth and manhood.
All who come into Heaven return into then vernal manhood...
Who from their youth have loved... a lawful companionship with one woman...
In the Heavens, all are in the flower of youth, and remain in it to eternity.
See Youth.
Women are ignorant of this up to the youthful age...
Those not arrived at the youthful age...
In their first youth...
I remembered thy youth () = the state of man's reformation.

Those in love truly conjugial... return to their manhood and youth; the males... become young men; and the wives... young women... As such continue to grow young more interiorly, it follows that love truly conjugial continually increases... The reason man thus grows young in Heaven, is that he then enters into the marriage of good and truth...
